chunks: Muhammad ibn Umar al-Hafiz al-Baghdadi narrated to us, saying: My father narrated to me, Abu Muhammad al-Hasan ibn Abdullah al-Razi, saying: My master Ali ibn Musa al-Rida narrated to me, saying: My father Musa ibn Ja'far narrated to me, saying: My father Ja'far ibn Muhammad narrated to me, saying: My father Muhammad ibn Ali narrated to me, saying: My father Ali ibn al-Hussein narrated to me, saying: My father al-Hussein narrated to me, saying: My brother al-Hasan ibn Ali narrated to me, saying: My father Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon them all) narrated to me.
The Prophet of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: "I and Ali were created from one light."

key_terms.صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ: peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the creation of the Prophet and Ali from one light?
ai.summary: This hadith, recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Khisal*, articulates the doctrine of *Nur Muhammad* (the Light of Muhammad) and *Nur Ali*, positing that the Prophet and Imam Ali share a singular, pre-eternal divine essence. It underscores the metaphysical unity of prophethood and imamate, serving as a foundational text for Shia cosmology and the spiritual hierarchy of the Ahl al-Bayt.
